cmd: ( m=quality/sealed_manifest.json; F() { echo "W7.7 FAIL: $1"; exit 1; }; uv run --locked pytest tests/guard/test_seal_immutability.py tests/unit/test_seal_classifier.py tests/unit/test_seal_config_agrees.py -q || F "GD-06, UT-16 or UT-17 is red"; n=0; for k in seal_start_date regular_season_end postseason_end_estimate sealed_game_types excluded_game_types prereg_tag; do grep -qxF "$(jq -r --arg k $k "\"\(\$k): \(.[\$k]|tojson)\"" $m)" config/seal.yml || F "$k in the manifest differs from config/seal.yml"; n=$((n+1)); done; [ $n -eq 6 ] || F "checked $n of 6 constants"; jq -e "has(\"postseason_gamepks\") or has(\"postseason_appended_at\") or has(\"postseason\")" $m >/dev/null && F "a postseason block is present at M1"; jq -e ".partition_field == \"gameData.datetime.officialDate\"" $m >/dev/null || F "partition_field is not officialDate"; jq -e ".regular_gamepks | length > 0 and all(type == \"number\" and . == floor) and . == unique" $m >/dev/null || F "regular_gamepks is not a sorted list of distinct integers"; jq -e ".regular_game_count == (.regular_gamepks | length)" $m >/dev/null || F "regular_game_count does not match the list"; h=$(jq -r "(.regular_gamepks + (.postseason_gamepks // [])) | sort | .[]" $m | shasum -a 256 | cut -d" " -f1); [ "$h" = "$(jq -r .gamepks_sha256 $m)" ] || F "gamepks_sha256 does not recompute"; src=$(jq -r .regular_gamepks_source.path $m); if [ -f "$src" ] && [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$src" | cut -d" " -f1)" = "$(jq -r .regular_gamepks_source.sha256 $m)" ]; then s=$(jq -r .seal_start_date $m); [ "$(jq -c --arg s $s "[.dates[].games[] | select(.gameType == \"R\" and .season == (\$s[0:4]) and .officialDate >= \$s) | .gamePk] | unique" "$src")" = "$(jq -c .regular_gamepks $m)" ] || F "regular_gamepks differs from the rule applied to its source"; echo "source recomputed: the rule gives the same $(jq .regular_game_count $m) gamePks"; else echo "source check vacuous: $src is absent or has other bytes in this tree"; fi; echo "W7.7 OK: $(jq .regular_game_count $m) regular-tail gamePks, 6 constants equal config/seal.yml, no postseason block, gamepks_sha256 recomputes" )
title: The sealed manifest, regular tail
